info.name: PaySwift - Transfer Initiation API
info.description:
Transfer initiation contract checks for the PaySwift QA assignment, run against the public mock `POST https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts`.

The mock echoes the request and adds an integer `id`, used here as the generated transaction id. It cannot enforce business rules, so the negative scenarios below are documented for a real PaySwift environment rather than executed against the mock. The full matrix with expected UI states is in `docs/NEGATIVE_API_TEST_MATRIX.md`.

| # | Scenario | Expected status | Key assertion |
|---|----------|-----------------|---------------|
| N1 | Missing / expired / tampered JWT | 401 | No transfer created; app routes to re-login |
| N2 | Valid token, sender account not owned by caller | 403 | No data about the other account leaked |
| N3 | Same idempotencyKey + same body replayed | 200/201 with original txn id | Exactly one debit; ledger unchanged on replay |
| N4 | Same idempotencyKey + different body | 409 or 422 | Request rejected; original txn untouched |
| N5 | Amount below minimum (9.99) / above per-txn max (50000.01) | 422 | Error code identifies the rule |
| N6 | Amount with 3 decimals (10.005), zero, negative, string, NaN | 400 / 422 | No rounding on the server |
| N7 | Insufficient balance | 422 | Balance unchanged |
| N8 | Daily cumulative limit exceeded (sum + amount > 100000.00) | 422 | Limit counted per IST calendar day |
| N9 | Unknown / closed / blocked receiver | 404 / 422 | No debit |
| N10 | Missing idempotencyKey header/field | 400 | Server refuses non-idempotent money movement |
| N11 | Unsupported currency, malformed JSON, wrong Content-Type | 400 / 415 | |
| N12 | Burst of requests from one user/device | 429 + Retry-After | Client backs off |
| N13 | Locked account (3 failed PINs) | 423 or 403 | Lock expiry honoured after 15 min |
| N14 | Core banking timeout / downstream 5xx | 502 / 503 / 504 | Client shows "Transaction Pending - Do Not Retry" and polls status by idempotencyKey; no auto-retry with a new key |

request.description: Posts the assignment payload and checks status, latency, headers, schema, echoed fields and the generated transaction id.
